profile.headline: Software Engineer at NVIDIA
profile.summary: Software Engineer with interests in designing, implementing, and debugging efficient, scalable datapath software.  Broad experiences include code development for bootloaders, diagnostic suites, Linux kernel device drivers, RTOS firmware, node provisioning automation, storage benchmark utilities, log translation and metric aggregation, and distributed object stores.

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description: Infrastructure Engineer for the storage team with focus on application scaling on distributed object storage for DVR content.  Leverage previous experiences on software architecture and storage systems to help determine ways to support more customer playbacks and recordings while saving on equipment costs.  Software tool development for data migration, performance testing, manageability, metrics analysis, and monitoring solutions.  Constantly playing with new and old technologies.

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
Embedded RTOS firmware for enterprise hard drives.
BSP development: U-boot and Linux Kernel device driver development for custom SOC: SCSI, block layer, DMA engines, NAPI, TCP, I2C.
Performance testing/integration of open source applications on ARM.
Integration and debug of clustered storage nodes leveraging both open-source (CEPH) and customer applications for distributed storage systems.

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
Firmware development involved with platform initialization, hardware validation, and system tests on enterprise storage platforms.  Custom board bring-up developing bootloaders, tools, Linux drivers, scripts.  Experience with PowerPC and x86 platform firmware.

BIOS/UEFI, U-Boot, Linux

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
FPGA network router design
http://onl.arl.wustl.edu/
Designed and validated modules to increase functionality of the router providing filtering based on TCP flags and filtering based on probability sampling.  Also added a statistics module to monitor filter hits across the router.

VHDL, Testbench, TCP/IP
